# HAND-WRITTEN sample (not recorded on the box): `lspci -vv` text for the two B70s and the PCIe path above each, in
# the format lspci prints, trimmed to the lines offload_links.sh reads (the device header and LnkCap / LnkSta). Device
# names and the chain are illustrative; the box's recorded output replaces this file's role in the record
# (docs/probe-offload-<date>.md). Lines starting with '#' are the fixture's own: `# chain <card> <root> .. <card>` is
# the sysfs path the script reads on the box (/sys/bus/pci/devices/<bdf>), `# expect <line>` what the parser prints.
# chain 0000:04:00.0 0000:00:02.0 0000:02:00.0 0000:03:01.0 0000:04:00.0
# chain 0000:08:00.0 0000:00:03.0 0000:06:00.0 0000:07:01.0 0000:08:00.0
